answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable stake that is slashed when its attestations prove false, so creating thousands of fake identities means funding each one at real cost. A Sybil swarm then hits a canyon of expense before it can sway a vote: at its nadir, an attacker must choose between paying for every puppet or abandoning the attack, while honest agents keep a steady pulse of verified work that earns their stake back over time.
